title: Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate
system: Plasma Chamber Liners, Shields & Thermal Hardware
alloyReason: Bead-blasted Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is chosen for Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate where controlled surface roughness (Ra 3.2-6.3 µm) improves adhesion of applied coatings or bonding agents. The 345 MPa yield with 30% elongation provides sufficient ductility for forming operations while maintaining the excellent corrosion resistance characteristic of CP titanium. This surface preparation is tailored for Ceramic heater core clamping plate. This rationale is driven by ceramic heater core clamping plate and specific design requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for chamber shield geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse at 200W fiber laser
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for ceramic heater core application
commonFailures: Metal particle shedding >1e10 at/cm2 - eliminated by UHP VAR+ESR double-melt + electropolished ID — critical for ceramic heater core performance

faq.q: What is the magnetic permeability of Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti has a magnetic permeability µ < 1.0001 (effectively non-magnetic), essential for ceramic heater core in electron beam lithography, ion implantation, and SEM/EDX tool chambers where magnetic materials would deflect charged particle beams. Permeability is verified per ASTM A342 for each production batch.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate?
faq.a: Each Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for ceramic heater core.
